caption_used: 该折线图展示了lattice、FLAT与OURS三种方法在训练过程中F1分数的演变趋势。横轴为训练轮数（epoch），范围从0到18；纵轴为F1分数，范围从0.55至0.90。红色实线带方形标记代表lattice方法，初始F1值约为0.59，在epoch=16时达到约0.85。蓝色实线带圆形标记代表FLAT方法，起始F1值约为0.79，收敛速度较快。黄色实线带三角形标记代表OURS方法，初始F1值约为0.82，最终在epoch=16达到约0.90。值得注意的是，FLAT方法在epoch=8附近即超越OURS，两者在中间阶段表现接近，而lattice方法虽起步较慢但在后期展现出与FLAT相当的增长速率。
raw_response:
The figure presents a line graph illustrating the evolution of F1 scores for three methods—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—across training epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch (次)", represents the number of training iterations, ranging from 0 to 18 with uniform intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "F1分数", displays the F1 score, spanning from 0.55 to 0.90 with uniform intervals of 0.05. The red solid line with square markers represents the lattice method, starting at approximately 0.59 at epoch 0 and reaching approximately 0.85 at epoch 16. The blue solid line with circular markers represents the FLAT method, beginning at approximately 0.79 at epoch 0 and increasing to approximately 0.84 at epoch 16. The yellow solid line with triangular markers represents the OURS method, initiating at approximately 0.82 at epoch 0 and culminating at approximately 0.90 at epoch 16.
